children: Trevor F. Lauer, an officer serving as Vice Chairman & Group Pres., sold common stock in a transaction reported on September 1, 2026. The sale was reported as a Sale with a weighted average price of $135.712 per share. The total sale amount reported was $678,560. After the transaction, Lauer directly owned 73,122 shares of common stock and indirectly owned 4,192 shares. The filing notes the weighted average price reflects sales ranging from $135.59 to $135.815 and that 4,192 indirect shares include holdings under the DTE Energy Company Savings and Stock Ownership Plan as of a plan statement dated September 1, 2026.
